title: Phase 3: roughness guard, per-stem tuning, and calibration against the user's ratings
description: essentia Dissonance (mix minus the sum of stems) as a guard; per-stem tuning; audio leave-one-out; EQ suggestions from the transcribed notes; scripts/rate-render.py and check-stems --calibrate (Spearman rho between the user's stars and the objective, with proposed weight tweaks that are never applied automatically).

comments.author: home
comments.text: User request (2026-09-26): the checker should name the exact frequencies to cut, as a DJ or mix engineer would. A prototype works: per stem and chord span, off-chord notes WITH octave from a constant-Q spectrum of the harmonic part, ranked by energy, marking notes that are off under every chord (safe to notch) vs only some chords. Used on Ave House: notches at 208/233/277/370 Hz (q12) raised the objective 74.8 to 76.7; deeper cuts plus overtone notches tripped the energy guard. Build it into check-stems as suggestions ('bright: eq peak -8@233 q12, A#3 off-key under every chord, 3.6% of the stem'). Prototype: .claude/skills/write-score/scripts/notch-finder.py.
